details: Published DEB, RPM, AppImage, and Pacman packages from source commit 35d6776a. The release adopts upstream CHIRP f28d9202 with 99 upstream commits, adds the upstream-review and pinned-catalog export tooling, keeps NewChirp driver precedence, fixes TK-359 6.25 kHz decoding/name order/TX display, aligns MD-UV380 DFU writes with dmrconfig/QDMR, retries short DM-32UV flash reads, and accepts CSV files whose rows are each wrapped as one quoted field. New upstream radios include BTECH UV-PRO, Kenwood TH-K20/TM-D750, Yaesu FTM-150E, and Zastone ZT-D9000. Verification: flutter analyze passed; all 258 Flutter tests passed with the bundled Python 3.13 runtime; 722 bundled Python tests passed with two fixture-dependent skips; the Ubuntu 20.04 ABI check passed with maximum GLIBC 2.18; DEB, RPM, and Pacman metadata and embedded version 1.0.80 were verified; DEB and AppImage Xvfb smoke tests passed; the AppImage launched under host Wayland and X11; package payloads include the new CHIRP pin, TK-359, MD-UV380, DM-32UV, and CSV changes and omit GLVND/EGL/GLES loaders; all public downloads returned HTTP 200; and the Linux platform manifest reports 1.0.80.
